headline: Your residency, your citizenship, your Plan B. Don’t let the world decide for you.
lede: Join global citizens and specialists in residency, citizenship and wealth planning, alongside government representatives, for two days in Lisbon. Bring these perspectives together as you explore where to live, invest and plan your family’s future.
about_heading: Capital is becoming mobile, and the right decisions need the right people in the room
programme_heading: Two days, organized around the decisions and topics that matter most
setting_heading: Lisbon, a European capital with a global outlook
partner_logos_on_site: CapitalPartners, a member of Gaw Capital
